description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Misthollow Griffin, untapping a basic Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Misthollow Griffin, adding {R}.
When Misthollow Griffin dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Misthollow Griffin from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Misthollow Griffin token, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Misthollow Griffin token, adding {R}.
Cast Misthollow Griffin from exile by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
